appraisal_events.evidence: Elle laissa pleuvoir sur moi la lumière de son regard bleu, hésita un instant, déplia et tendit la tige de son bras, pencha en avant son corps, qui se redressa rapidement en arrière comme un arbuste qu'on a couché... — Ah ! mais, c'est très aimable, dit Mme de Guermantes d'un ton volontairement banal, comme si je lui eusse apporté son manteau. Je suis très flattée.
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite Saint-Loup's desperate efforts to warm the exchange and his praise of the narrator on his behalf, Mme de Guermantes greets the narrator with a stiff, springing-back gesture and answers in a deliberately banal, formulaic tone that the narrator himself likens to thanking someone for bringing her coat, treating his attention as a servant's function rather than a personal bond.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator is met with cool, impersonal politeness that the narration itself compares to a servant's courtesy, leaving him socially unrecognized despite Saint-Loup's advocacy on his behalf.
The forced proximity engineered by Saint-Loup yields no real connection; the passage ends in mutual silence, marking the failure of the hoped-for warmth.
